## v0.5.0-rc.1 · Composable Memory Plugins

This release candidate keeps the v0.4 Sidebar experience and upgrades the implementation to a composable, View-based memory system. Existing configuration, three-tier workflows, storage formats, and ordinary UI remain compatible. The only new user-facing controls are three disabled-by-default switches under **Settings → Memory System → Memory enhancements**.

### What ships

- One `dsh-mnemon` Starter plus sixteen independently published, version-locked packages: three Sources, one default Strategy, three optional Strategy enhancements, and nine Memory Space Providers.
- A narrow `ctx.mnemonMemory` runtime boundary, public `dsh-mnemon/extension-sdk`, isolated `dsh-mnemon/testing` fixtures, Fiber-owned registration, immutable turn Views, Source-local grants, and bounded execution.
- Optional scoped composition, light-context projection, and current-turn auto-capture guidance. These extensions compose through distinct slots and remain disabled unless the user enables them.
- Independent package, tarball, Node 20/22/24, Windows, Headless, copied-data upgrade, and real `v0.4.7 → v0.5.0-rc.1` Registry upgrade gates.

### Community requests

- [#110](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/110): auto-capture now offers an opt-in current-turn recording policy. It is not an unsupervised background writer, so the broader request remains open.
- [#40](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/40): light-context provides a bounded projection policy. Revisioned incremental injection remains an upstream-dependent open item.
- [#77](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/issues/77): scoped composition generalizes the existing global/project memory use case with ordered Sources and a writable subset.

### Install

This prerelease is available on the npm `rc` channel and does not replace `latest`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.0-rc.1
```

Use `headless` instead of `web` for a Headless profile. Back up the effective memory root, Documents, DSH profile/configuration, and separately managed Provider data before trying a prerelease.

Full compatibility boundaries, rollback instructions, and extension limitations are documented in the [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.0-rc.1/docs/en/releases/v0.5.0-rc.1.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.0-rc.1/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.0-rc.1.md).
